I. About IIIT Naya Raipur
Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee IIIT-Naya Raipur (IIIT-NR), established by
the International Institute of Information Technology University Act, 2013
of the Government of Chhattisgarh, is a joint initiative of the Chhattisgarh
State Government and National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC). The
institute is committed to pursuing excellence in higher education, research,
and development in information technology (IT) and other associated
disciplines. IIIT-NR firmly believes in bestowing knowledge dissemination
and imparting entrepreneurial skills to the students to enable them to
address real-world problems. To empower this vision, IIIT-NR provides
state-of-the-art research and education facilities and nurtures a campus
culture that fosters high energy and enthusiasm in every individual, clubbed
with the highest standard of professionalism.
Facilities:
The 50 acres of the lush green campus of IIIT-NR is enabled with Wi-Fi
connectivity and has excellent amenities for sports and other recreational
activities. The modern architecture of the buildings and the serene
environment of the campus foster an ambience for the students to engage in
creativity and innovation.

The institute has two state-of-the-art virtual classrooms of 120 capacity each
quipped with the latest video conferencing systems. The classrooms and laboratories
are equipped with state-of-the-art tools for teaching and learning. Some important
laboratories are the 3D Printing & Fabrication Lab, 5G Lab, Antenna and Microwave
Circuit Design Lab, Big Data Computing Lab, VLSI & Embedded Lab, Artificial
Intelligence & Deep Learning Lab, Communication Lab, Data Science Lab, IoT &
Sensor Lab, Robotics Lab, etc.
IIIT-NR Guest House 20 Rooms air-
conditioned, furnished and provided
with attached bathrooms with dining
facilities. Parents or guardians of the
students or experts can stay with the
approval of the competent authority.
Hostel Facilities::
IIIT-NR has four hostels for boys and three for
girls. Students can access campus networks and
computing facilities from their hostel rooms
through high-speed WiFi/LAN. All students are
required to stay in a hostel.

Canteen Facilities:
The institute has separate dining facilities for boys and girls in
their hostels. Additionally, it has a centralised canteen that serves
snacks, vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, general fast food, juice, and milk
products. The institute’s mess serves both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. The
mess is managed by a committee comprising students, staff, and faculty.
Sports Facilities:
Every hostel has a separate sports facility for indoor games, including table tennis
and badminton. A multi purpose indoor hall with four badminton courts cum a
basket ball court, one out door basketball court, two volleyball courts and one
football cum cricket ground are available. Indoor game facilities are available in
each hostel apart from the SAC (Student Activities Centre).

Gym:
Open-air Gym facilities with modern equipment are available separately for boys
and girls. A centralised indoor Gym facility is also available at SAC.
Auditorium
The institute has a centrally air-
conditioned auditorium with an
800-seat capacity for organising
large technical and cultural
events.
Amphitheatres:
The institute has two open-air
theatres with a capacity of 1500
and 1000 for its cultural activities.

II. Academic Programs
IIIT-NR currently runs three undergraduate programs: B. Tech. in Computer
Science & Engineering (CSE), B. Tech. in Electronics & Communication
Engineering (ECE) and B. Tech. in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence
(DSAI). These credit-based programs are designed to foster core skills with
innovation and entrepreneurship skills among students. The dynamic
structure of the curriculum orchestrates with the changing needs of industry
and academia. IIIT-NR also runs postgraduate and doctoral programs as

III. Admission to B.Tech. Programs:
Admission to the B.Tech. programmes at IIIT Naya Raipur is governed solely by
the JEE (Main) 2026 rank. There are 90 seats available in each CSE, ECE, and
DSAI. Additionally there are some female only supernumerary seats and 1
Kashmiri Migrant seat in each branch. Eligible candidates may apply under the
following categories:
All India Quota Chhattisgarh Quota NTPC Quota
Eligibility Criteria, Seats and Reservation

All India Quota: 35% of seats, amounting to 95 seats (32 in CSE, 32 in ECE
and 31 in DSAI) are in this category. Additionally there are 24 female only
supernumerary seats (8 in each branch), reserved only for female candidates.
Candidates who completed their school education in any part of India can apply
under this category. These seats will be filled through JoSAA/CSAB 2026
counselling (visit https://josaa.nic.in). So their eligibility will be as per the
business rules of JoSAA 2026. All reservations will be as per the
Government of India norms.
NTPC Quota: 15% of seats, amounting to 40 seats (16 in CSE, 17 in ECE and 17
in DSAI) are in this category. Additionally there are 10 female only
supernumerary seats (3 in CSE, 3 in DSAI, 4 in ECE ), reserved only for female
candidates. Candidates employed with NTPC or their wards who completed their
school education in any part of India can apply under this category. Their
eligibility will be as per the business rules of JoSAA/CSAB 2026. All

reservations will be as per the Government of India norms. These seats
will be filled through the IIIT-NR online counselling process (visit
https://www.iiitnr.ac.in/content/b-tech-admission-2026) Candidates seeking
admission under NTPC quota seats shall submit a certificate in the prescribed
format (Annexure I) from the Nodal Authority of NTPC, certifying that the
candidate is eligible to apply for the NTPC quota.
The candidates applying for OBC-NCL under All India and NTPC quota must
submit the OBC-NCL certificate in the format (Annexure II) provided by the JoSAA
Other formats are not acceptable.

Chhattisgarh Quota: 50% of seats amount to 135 seats (45 in CSE, 45 in ECE
and 45 in DSAI) in this category. All the reservations under this quota will be as
per the norms of the Govt. of Chhattisgarh. These seats will be filled through
the IIIT-NR online counselling process (visit https://www.iiitnr.ac.in/
content/b-tech-admission-2026) The following are the eligibility criteria for
admission under this quota:
Candidates must pass the 10th and 12th standard examinations from the

schools in the State of Chhattisgarh only.
2.Candidates must have scored 50% aggregate marks in Chemistry, Physics and
Mathematics (45% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwD candidates) in their 12th
standard examination.
3.Candidates’ date of birth must be on or after October 01, 2000. For the
candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL and PwD, the upper age limit is
relaxable by three years, i.e. SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PwD candidates’ date of
birth must be on or after October 01, 1997. Only the date of birth recorded by
the Secondary Education Board will be considered.
4.Candidates who passed their 12th standard examination or any other
qualifying examination in 2024, 2025 or 2026 shall be eligible. The
candidates who appeared in the 12th standard or equivalent qualifying
examinations in 2023, did not pass in 2023, but passed in 2024 are not
eligible.
5.Candidates seeking admission under reserved categories (SC/ ST/ OBC -
NCL) have to mandatorily submit their caste/category certificate issued by a
competent authority of Govt. of Chhattisgarh only in their name at the
time of application.
6.OBC-NCL candidates are required to produce an OBC-NCL certificate issued,
by the competent authorities, on or after 1st April 2026.
As per Govt. of Chhattisgarh norms, in addition to the vertical reservations

(SC/ST/OBC NCL), the following horzental reservations under the above
verticals:
Women – 30%
Children of Ex-Servicemen – 5%
Children or Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters – 3%
Persons with Disabilities – 5%
^ 2% of seats are reserved for the candidates of the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal
Group (PVTP) from the seats reserved for Scheduled Tribes (ST).
8.The wards/grandchildren of Freedom Fighters (FF) shall have to submit a
certificate (Annexure III) issued by the competent authorities that his/her
parent/grandparent is a freedom fighter.
9.The wards of Ex‐servicemen shall have to submit a certificate (Annexure IV)
issued by the Army Commanding Officer or Zila Sainik Welfare Officers.
10.For Persons with Disabilities (PwD), the following certificates are required
to be submitted:
i. Certificate issued by District Medical Board certifying disability
ii. Certificate from Superintendent, Government of India, and Ministry of
Labour certifying that candidate is eligible to study for the subject applied.
A caste/category certificate issued in the name of either of the parents

(Mother/ Father) is unacceptable.
Forwards of Kashmiri Migrants, a certificate from the competent authority (Sub‐
Divisional Officer ‐ Revenue) is required.

IV Application Procedure and Fee
Candidates desirous of seeking admission to IIIT-NR under the CG quota and/or
NTPC quota must apply through the institute’s online portal
(https://www.iiitnr.ac.in/content/b-tech-admission-2026). Offline applications
or applications via email will not be considered.
Application & Counselling Process: Candidates applying for admissions
shall be required to remit a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- online.
Based on the online applications received and their respective JEE (Main) 2026
rank, merit lists will be published for each category. The entire admission
process will strictly be conducted online as per the announced schedule. Any
changes in the deadlines or alterations in the process will be duly communicated
on our website. Any physical solicitation concerning the Admission Process will
not be entertained.
